watchOut: The ranges exclude positioning, trip charges and taxes, so a real quote can be higher.
It lowered every range in autumn 2026 (light jets were $6,800 to $9,900 an hour on October 3).

rates.label: Light Jet
rates.note: Whole-aircraft planning range before positioning, trip charges and taxes, with a two-hour billable minimum.

name: Jet Partners
roleBasis: Says it has been "arranging private jet charter since 2010" and tells buyers to review the "identified carrier, aircraft, complete price, and trip terms in a written proposal before booking".
summary: Charter arranger with a pricing page of planning ranges and a quote page that tells buyers what to compare.
differentiator: Its quote page lists what to compare between proposals: total price, taxes, charter-arranger and carrier charges, third-party charges, and what happens if the aircraft is substituted. It links the FAA Part 135 list, and its pricing page shows how a total is built: billable hours, a trip-fee allowance, 7.5% excise tax and the $5.30 segment tax.
priceNote: Its worked example shows $14,000 to $27,000 one way for a light jet from Teterboro to Miami Opa-locka with six passengers, assuming an aircraft near the departure airport, and calls it a whole-aircraft planning estimate.
operatorDisclosure: Says its written proposal identifies the carrier and aircraft before booking. It shows ARGUS, Wyvern and IS-BAO logos with the note "A logo does not guarantee a particular flight".
bestFor: Buyers who want a checklist of what to compare between proposals, and a planning range that is not a base rate.
skipIf: You are comparing against base-rate tables and expect similar numbers. Its ranges are a different basis.
